title: TexLab error when inserting text before multibyte characters

labels.name: bug-regression
labels.description: wrong behavior that was introduced in a previous commit (please bisect)

labels.name: has:bisected
labels.description: issue has been tracked to a specific commit

body:
### Neovim version (nvim -v)

v0.7.0-dev+714-g3aff3d634, also exists in v0.6.0

### Language server name/version

texlab 3.3.1

### Operating system/version

Arch Linux

### :checkhealth

```markdown
lspconfig: require("lspconfig.health").check()
========================================================================
  - INFO: texlab: configuration checked.

nvim: health#nvim#check
========================================================================
## Configuration
  - WARNING: Missing user config file: /home/zeertzjq/.config/nvim/init.vim
    - ADVICE:
      - :help |init.vim|

## Performance
  - INFO: Build type: Debug
  - WARNING: Non-optimized (DEBUG) build. Nvim will be slower.
    - ADVICE:
      - Install a different Nvim package, or rebuild with `CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo`.
      - https://github.com/neovim/neovim/wiki/FAQ

## Remote Plugins
  - OK: Up to date

## terminal
  - INFO: key_backspace (kbs) terminfo entry: key_backspace=\177
  - INFO: key_dc (kdch1) terminfo entry: key_dc=\E[3~
  - INFO: $COLORTERM='truecolor'
```


### Steps to reproduce using "nvim -u minimal_init.lua"

This is `/tmp/minimal_init.lua`:
```lua
vim.lsp.set_log_level('trace')
require('vim.lsp.log').set_format_func(vim.inspect)
vim.cmd([[set rtp+=~/.local/share/nvim/site/pack/packer/start/nvim-lspconfig]])
require('lspconfig').texlab.setup({})
vim.o.showmode = false
```

This is `/tmp/tmp.tex`:
```tex
\begin{document}
→
\end{document}
```

1. Run `VIMRUNTIME=./runtime ./build/bin/nvim --clean -u /tmp/minimal_init.lua /tmp/tmp.tex`
2. Press `2ggII`


### Expected behavior

No errors. LSP client doesn't quit.

### Actual behavior

`Client 1 quit with exit code 1 and signal 0`
